source.title: Call for Applicants - WEC Members (August 2019)
source.content:
The **WCA Ethics Committee (WEC)** is seeking new members to help them with their mission! The applications are open to everyone; it’s not a requirement to hold a current position in the WCA to be considered.

**What does the WEC do?**
- Maintaining and updating the Code of Ethics.
- Ensures that all procedures followed by WCA Staff abide by the Code of Ethics.
- Performs independent investigations if any WCA Staff member is not compliant with said Code of Ethics.
- Confidant for Registered Speedcubers that request investigations.
- Functions as the board of appeal if any involved party disagrees with a decision made by the WCA Disciplinary Committee.

The official rights and duties of the WEC are documented in [WCA Motion 10.2019.3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.3%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf).
<!-- break -->
**The qualities and requirements expected of candidates are:**
- Clear background
- Personal time management skills
- Ability to discuss reasoning and ideas
- Familiarity with WCA activities

The application period is open for applicants to submit their application documents from now until **September 11th, 2019, 23:59 UTC** to Callum Goodyear ([cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org)).

**Candidacy documents must be in PDF format, and must include:**
- A brief personal introduction
- Summary of activities done within the cubing community
- Motivation for applying to join the WEC

Applicants can expect an immediate reply to confirm the receipt of the application, and may later receive a request to be interviewed. Anyone with questions about applying can contact Callum Goodyear (cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org).

After the application period, the WEC Leader will make a selection and the new members will be announced once applicants have accepted the positions.

Thank you for your candidacies and support!

translation.title: WCA 道德委员会成员招募（2019 年 8 月）
translation.content:
**WCA 道德委员会（WEC）**正在招募新成员，帮助委员会完成工作！申请向所有人开放，申请者不必目前在 WCA 担任职务。

**WEC 的工作是什么？**

- 维护和更新道德准则。
- 确保 WCA 工作人员遵循的各项程序符合道德准则。
- 如有 WCA 工作人员不遵守道德准则，开展独立调查。
- 为提出调查请求的已注册速拧选手提供保密沟通渠道。
- 如相关当事方不认同 WCA 纪律委员会的决定，担任申诉审理机构。

WEC 的正式权利与职责载于 [WCA 动议 10.2019.3](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.3%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf)。

**我们希望候选人具备以下条件：**

- 无不良记录。
- 良好的个人时间管理能力。
- 能讨论观点并说明理由。
- 熟悉 WCA 的各项活动。

申请自即日起开放，截止时间为 **2019 年 9 月 11 日 23:59 UTC**。请将材料发送给 Callum Goodyear（[cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org)）。

**申请材料须为 PDF 格式，并包括：**

- 简短的个人介绍。
- 在魔方社区所做工作的概述。
- 申请加入 WEC 的原因。

我们会及时回复确认收到申请，之后可能邀请申请者面试。有关申请的任何疑问，可联系 Callum Goodyear（cgoodyear@worldcubeassociation.org）。

申请截止后，WEC 负责人将选定人选，待申请者接受职务后公布新成员。

感谢大家的申请与支持！
